construction_operations.operation: Install bearings and verify temporary stability
Lift precast span and secure temporary works
Fit conventional running rails and gauge-control fasteners
Install the candidate-specific propulsion and electrical equipment
Survey gauge, cant, alignment, joints and dynamic clearance
Inspect, test and independently release completed railway

vehicle_assembly_sequence.operation: Cut and fixture aluminium sills, bows and bogie hardpoints
Join frame and verify diagonal, twist and load-path datums
Prepare, bond and retain GFRP panels and roof/floor sandwiches
Fit doors, glazing, seating, accessible zones and flush PV
Manufacture or procure identical unpowered bogies; inspect wheelsets, bearings and welds
Install independent brakes, WSP, parking and odometry
Fit passive LIM fin and hangers; verify hot and suspension-travel clearance
Install independently fused service/essential supply, HVAC and low-voltage equipment
Weigh equipped car and measure CG/inertia; perform structural, insulation, brake and interface tests

assumptions: Hours are model-derived Class C process/labour scenarios, not timed work instructions, crew-hours, qualified cycle times or capacity evidence.
